tool_input.command: $root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path; foreach ($relative in @('.venv', '.uv-cache')) { $target = Join-Path $root $relative; $resolvedParent = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $target)).Path; if ($resolvedParent -cne $root) { throw "Refusing cleanup outside repo: $target" }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Recurse -Force } }; Get-Item -LiteralPath '.\generated.txt' | Select-Object Name, Length
